import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class MaxFlow {
        static class Edge {
            int v, capacity, rev;
            Edge(int v, int capacity, int rev) {
                this.v = v;
                this.capacity = capacity;
                this.rev = rev;
            }
        }

        List<List<Edge>> adj;
        int[] level, iter;
        int s, t;

        MaxFlow(int V, int start, int end) {
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            level = new int[V];
            iter = new int[V];
            s = start;
            t = end;
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
            adj.get(u).add(new Edge(v, cap, adj.get(v).size()));
            adj.get(v).add(new Edge(u, 0, adj.get(u).size() - 1));
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            level[s] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : adj.get(u)) {
                    if (e.capacity > 0 && level[e.v] < 0) {
                        level[e.v] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] >= 0;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int flow) {
            if (u == t) return flow;
            for (; iter[u] < adj.get(u).size(); iter[u]++) {
                Edge e = adj.get(u).get(iter[u]);
                if (e.capacity > 0 && level[e.v] == level[u] + 1) {
                    int pushed = dfs(e.v, Math.min(flow, e.capacity));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.capacity -= pushed;
                        adj.get(e.v).get(e.rev).capacity += pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxFlow() {
            long total = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
                int flow;
                while ((flow = dfs(s, Integer.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) {
                    total += flow;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static int n, t;
    static int[][] ck = new int[15][15];
    static String[] grid = new String[15];
    static String[] es = new String[15];
    static int y, x;
    static int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dx = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static int[][][] node_id = new int[15][15][65];

    static void traverse() {
        boolean[][] visited = new boolean[n][n];
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{y, x});
        ck[y][x] = 1;
        int level = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int size = q.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                int[] now = q.poll();
                int nowY = now[0], nowX = now[1];
                for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
                    int ny = nowY + dy[dir];
                    int nx = nowX + dx[dir];
                    if (ny < 0 || ny >= n || nx < 0 || nx >= n) continue;
                    if (ck[ny][nx] != 0 || grid[ny].charAt(nx) == 'Y') continue;
                    ck[ny][nx] = level;
                    q.offer(new int[]{ny, nx});
                }
            }
            level++;
            if (level > t) level = t;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            grid[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    y = i;
                    x = j;
                }
            }
        }

        // Read two lines (possibly empty lines)
        br.readLine();
        br.readLine();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            es[i] = br.readLine();
        }

        traverse();

        int total_nodes = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if ('0' <= grid[i].charAt(j) && grid[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    if (ck[i][j] == 0) ck[i][j] = t;
                    for (int t_idx = 0; t_idx < ck[i][j]; t_idx++) {
                        node_id[i][j][t_idx] = ++total_nodes;
                    }
                }
                if ('1' <= es[i].charAt(j) && es[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    node_id[i][j][ck[i][j]] = ++total_nodes;
                }
            }
        }

        int INF = 1000000000;
        int s = 0;
        int e = total_nodes + 3;
        MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow(total_nodes + 5, s, e);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if ('1' <= grid[i].charAt(j) && grid[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    mf.addEdge(s, node_id[i][j][0], grid[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
                for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
                    int ny = i + dy[dir];
                    int nx = j + dx[dir];
                    if (ny < 0 || ny >= n || nx < 0 || nx >= n) continue;
                    if (grid[ny].charAt(nx) == 'Y' || grid[ny].charAt(nx) == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int t_idx = 0; ; t_idx++) {
                        if (node_id[i][j][t_idx] == 0) break;
                        if (t_idx == ck[i][j] && es[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && es[i].charAt(j) <= '9') break;
                        if (node_id[ny][nx][t_idx + 1] != 0) {
                            mf.addEdge(node_id[i][j][t_idx], node_id[ny][nx][t_idx + 1], INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if ('1' <= es[i].charAt(j) && es[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    for (int t_idx = 0; t_idx < ck[i][j]; t_idx++) {
                        mf.addEdge(node_id[i][j][t_idx], node_id[i][j][t_idx + 1], INF);
                    }
                    mf.addEdge(node_id[i][j][ck[i][j]], e, es[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        long answer = mf.maxFlow();
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
